title: Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation of Novel Spiro Imidazobenzodiazepines to Identify Improved Inhaled Bronchodilators
screen_reason: Med-chem lead optimisation of spiro imidazobenzodiazepine GABA_A receptor ligands as non-CNS-penetrant inhaled bronchodilators. Asserts and measures a mechanism end to end (benzodiazepine-site occupancy, airway smooth muscle relaxation, reversal of bronchoconstriction), so not the dismech#16882 apical shape; docking has wet confirmation, so not the dismech#16883 shape either. Decided on PMC full text, not the abstract alone.
method_kinds: in silico; in chemico; in vitro; ex vivo; animal
dismech_gaps: No node for GABA_AR benzodiazepine-site occupancy on airway smooth muscle: needs a gaba_a_receptor_agonism module as third sibling to beta2_adrenergic_receptor_agonism and muscarinic_receptor_antagonism. Also no node for the ex vivo/in vivo predictivity negative, nor for the CNS-exclusion negative.
note: No record for shake-flask aqueous solubility: no biological system, and the paper gives pH 7.2 in the Table 1 footnote against pH 7.4 in the Results and Methods. Paper is not open access, so records are abstract-cited with full-text sections named in each header comment. OpenScientist run committed in dismech research/nam_mining/.

title: Establishing Functional Retina in a Dish: Progress and Promises of Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell-Based Retinal Neuron Differentiation
note: Methods review of iPSC retinal protocols. Organoid record augmented (pre-existing); RGC and photoreceptor records new. Model links are MEASURES (wild-type, no disease lesion). title: Human iPSC-derived midbrain organoids functionally integrate into striatum circuits and restore motor function in a mouse model of Parkinson's disease
note: Three records: midbrain organoid (Organoid), 6-OHDA-lesioned mouse host and the organoid-into-striatum graft chimera (both AnimalModel). All three curated into DisMech (Parkinsons_Disease entry) via dismech#17536, merged 2026-11-16; present_in_dismech set true (assessed 2026-11-19). Open question: whether the graft's cell-therapy restoration is a model relationship or a treatment (dismech#17534).

title: De novo drug design based on patient gene expression profiles via deep learning
In silico study to recognize novel angiotensin-converting-enzyme-I inhibitors by 2D-QSAR and constraint-based molecular simulations
note: In silico 2D-QSAR (GA-MLR) for ACE inhibition plus docking/MD/ADMET virtual screen. Registry-only on the nam-mining triage gate: the model predicts a drug-target activity endpoint, not a disease mechanism, and CVD is only the stated motivation, so no DisMech anchor (the QSAR shape recorded in dismech#16882; docking-without-wet-confirmation touches dismech#16883). Abstract-only; no OpenScientist run. One record (docking/MD/ADMET folded in as applications of the one characterised model).

title: Three-dimensional bioprinting of in vitro tumor organoid and organ-on-a-chip models
note: Review (MRS Bulletin 48:643-656) of the Skardal lab's bioprinted tumour organoid and organ-on-a-chip work; no PMID or PMC copy. Free to read at Springer but unlicensed (bronze): only its abstract is cached, and the records rest on the primary papers it cites (cached, 89 quotes verified). No mechanism asserted by the review: registry only, no DisMech issue. Most organoid studies hand-pipetted rather than bioprinted, so the platform record is named for its hydrogel. Open granularity questions: the 2015 static liver-tumour hybrid organoid (pmid:25777294) is folded into the metastasis-on-a-chip record but may be its own Organoid record; lymph-node vs PBMC immune-enhanced variants kept as one record; the Wnt invasion assay in the review's Fig 3a has no primary source in the cited paper (pmid:33042963). pmid:33042963 claims EGFRvIII resistance to first-generation EGFR inhibitors was observed in its model: a possible DisMech candidate.

title: New trends for osteoarthritis: Biomaterials, models and modeling
note: Abstract-only: full text is subscription-only, not in PMC. Narrative review of OA drug-delivery biomaterials (therapies, not models), horse and zebrafish animal models, and 3D/organoid cartilage models. DisMech nam-mining triage (2026-11-19): registry only, no OpenScientist run - the abstract asserts no mechanism and a run could read only the abstract. dismech#18500 stays open for the full text and records what to re-triage. Records carry text_consulted: ABSTRACT_ONLY; seek the full text, then revisit the records, whether the 3D cartilage models are one NAM or several, whether "modeling" includes in silico work, and the triage (candidate anchors: Osteoarthritis Cartilage Matrix Catabolism -> osteoarthritis_cartilage_degradation#Matrix-Degrading Enzyme Upregulation; Chondrocyte Senescence -> cellular_senescence).
